Native Windows PowerShell Start-Sleep phase fixtures verify two samples and real timeouts, not the cause of the independent CI import/SMB waits.
UTC phase ordering assumes a stable host UTC clock and is not a monotonic duration or proof of a blocking syscall.
Initial native harness discarded nonempty stderr before saving; its content cannot be recovered. Corrected probes retain CLIXML progress messages.
